caseNameFull: Leight v. Schechter, Personnel Director and Chairman, Municipal Civil Service Commission
attorneys: Appellant-petitioner pro se. Peter Campbell Brown and Seymour B. Quel for appellees-respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial. federal question. The petition for writ of certiorari is denied.
